title: Getting Started with Modern Web Development
excerpt: A comprehensive guide to modern web development tools and practices.
content:
Modern Web Development in 2025

The web development landscape has evolved dramatically. Let's explore the key technologies shaping the future.

Frontend Frameworks

React, Vue, and Svelte continue to dominate the frontend space. Each brings unique advantages to the table.

Backend Evolution

Node.js with Express remains a solid choice, while new runtimes like Bun are pushing performance boundaries.

title: Building a Portfolio That Stands Out
excerpt: Learn how to create a developer portfolio that catches recruiters' attention.
content:
Stand Out From The Crowd

Your portfolio is your digital first impression. Here's how to make it count.

Show, Don't Tell

Instead of listing technologies, demonstrate them through real projects with live demos.

Performance Matters

A fast-loading portfolio shows you care about user experience and technical quality.

title: The Art of Clean Code
excerpt: Principles and practices for writing maintainable, readable code.
content:
Clean Code Principles

Writing code is easy. Writing code that others (and future you) can understand is hard.

Meaningful Names

Variables, functions, and classes should reveal intent. No more `x`, `temp`, or `data`.

Small Functions

Functions should do one thing, do it well, and do it only.
